title: Icon native coverage audit
scope: I01-I07 only; 10 direct Icon controls plus the planned Advanced/State/Visibility behavior.
coverage_policy: Rows are marked evidenced only from the named candidate81 native records. This is bounded representative coverage and does not claim exhaustive common Motion/State controls or arbitrary values.

source_context.separate_issue: site-check-preview-recovery-followup.json remains a separate recovery bug; it is not counted as Icon control coverage

dom_assertions: All 35 exported choices match their expected SVG shape/path and viewBox; final play choice survives reload as svg.pagecraft-icon-glyph.
cases.reload_devices: Final choice proof is recorded at 1280, 834, and 414px.

cases.purpose: decorative, named, and linked accessibility states
dom_assertions: empty unlinked label yields SVG aria-hidden=true with no role/name
named unlinked label yields role=img aria-label=Workshop status
named linked label yields A aria-label with inner SVG aria-hidden=true
linked empty label has no label and remains a link
cases.reload_devices: Decorative, named SVG, and named anchor proofs repeat at 1280, 834, and 414px.
limits: The empty linked label is a single exact state record; candidate82 Site checks recovery is separate.

dom_assertions: Internal new-tab link has target=_blank rel=noopener; email has target=_blank; phone is a link without target; unsafe URL falls back to labelled SVG with no href.
computed_assertions: Left/ Centre/ Right map to flex-start/center/flex-end; final Right alignment survives reload.
cases.reload_devices: Alignment reload proof covers 1280, 834, and 414px; link-mode record is exact but not a three-device reload matrix.
limits: Internal, email, and phone link modes were observed in a single Mobile run; do not generalize them to all three-device reload proof.

dom_assertions: Rendered SVG remains labelled Workshop status with no overflow.
computed_assertions: 40px glyph, rgb(32,80,128) color, 2.5px stroke, rgb(229,239,216) background, 8px 12px 10px 14px padding, and 16px radius.
cases.reload_devices: Exact computed values repeat at 1280, 834, and 414px.

dom_assertions: No overflow; responsive values remain on the expected SVG/wrapper.
computed_assertions: Override: Desktop 40px/8px 12px 10px 14px/16px; Tablet 32px/6px/12px; Mobile 24px/4px/8px. Reset: all three inherit the Desktop values.
cases.reload_devices: Override and reset records cover 1280, 834, and 414px after reload.

dom_assertions: id icon-proof, classes qa-icon status-icon, and outline survive reload at all three devices.
computed_assertions: settled pointer hover color is rgb(180,95,60); keyboard focus background is rgb(245,213,148); transition is 0.25s; source rules target hover/focus-visible.
cases.reload_devices: Identity reload covers all three devices; settled hover/focus proof is Desktop-specific.
limits: Representative state proof only; no exhaustive Motion/State/Hover/Focus option claim.

dom_assertions: Each selected breakpoint reports display:none while present=true; non-match removes the rendered Icon count; match reports one Icon.
cases.reload_devices: Visibility matrix and condition match/non-match records cover all three devices after reload.
limits: Visibility retains DOM while hidden; condition controls’ accessible labels require separate candidate82 native verification.

scope_gaps: No exhaustive arbitrary icon/style values or common Motion/State controls.
I03 internal/email/phone link modes are exact but observed in a single Mobile run rather than all-three-device reload proof.
I06 hover/focus computed proof is Desktop-specific; identity proof is all-device.
The Site checks recovery receipt is deliberately not counted as a successful Icon setting result.
